title: Oscar and the Asset
premise: Ivo Oyelaran, a crash investigator haunted by the unexplained accident that killed her family, receives a calendar invite from a handler who died in that same crash — and when she attends, she discovers the dead man left behind an operation: extracting Nadia Voss, a defector carrying proof that the summit's host government orchestrated the disaster. As Ivo smuggles Nadia toward the summit, she realizes the extraction itself may be the trap, designed to flush out and destroy the evidence — and anyone connected to it. Betrayed by the agency she trusted and hunted through a city locking down for the summit, Ivo must choose between the loyalty of her found team and the truth that could burn them all. In the end, she exposes the conspiracy at the summit itself at devastating personal cost, but gains a new family in Nadia and the survivors of the dead handler's network.
about_author: Kestrel Blackwood is the pen name of a former aviation safety analyst who spent a decade reconstructing accidents no one wanted explained. They write thrillers about ordinary people who refuse to accept official stories.

chapters.title: Row Twelve
chapters.summary: Ivo Oyelaran's POV. Two years after the crash that killed her family, Ivo still investigates it off the books, finding anomalies officials buried. On the anniversary, a calendar invitation arrives from Marcus Hale — the handler who died in row twelve — scheduling a meeting for tomorrow. The beat is grief sharpening into dread: someone is using her dead to reach her.

chapters.title: The Invitation
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. She verifies the invite's metadata: sent from Hale's authenticated account, timestamped hours before his death. At the meeting site — a shuttered airfield hangar — she finds instead a dying courier and a drive naming Nadia Voss, a defector with files on the crash. Ambushers arrive; a stranger named Teodor pulls her out. Beat: terror fused with purpose.

chapters.title: Dead Drop Protocol
chapters.summary: Alternating Ivo and Teodor POVs. Teodor reveals he was Hale's other asset; Hale anticipated his own death and built a contingency neither was meant to find alone. The drive contains half the proof — the rest is with Nadia, hiding in Riga before the summit. Beat: wary alliance forming between two strangers bound by a dead man's plan.

chapters.title: Riga Rules
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. In Riga they locate Nadia Voss, brilliant and paranoid, who refuses to trust anyone from 'the Agency' — until Ivo shows her the crash data matching her own file. Nadia agrees to move, but warns the extraction route Hale planned is too clean, too easy. Beat: fragile trust, first hint the plan itself is compromised.

chapters.title: The Clean Route
chapters.summary: Teodor's POV. Following Hale's extraction plan, Teodor realizes mid-route that every checkpoint has been quietly cleared for them — someone wants them moving along this path. He diverts them into the city's underbelly, burning a safehouse and losing their supplies. Beat: paranoia becomes certainty; the hunter understands he is prey.

chapters.title: What the Agency Knew
chapters.summary: Nadia's POV. Cornered in a tram depot, Nadia decrypts more of her files: the summit's host government commissioned the crash to eliminate Hale's entire network, and the Agency signed off to protect the summit. Ivo's family were collateral — or witnesses. Beat: rage and vertigo as Ivo's private tragedy becomes a political instrument.

chapters.title: Found Family, Falling Apart
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The trio shelters with remnants of Hale's old network — a forger, a comms tech, people who loved him. For one night Ivo experiences something like belonging again. Then the safehouse is betrayed from inside the network; the forger is taken. Beat: warmth curdling into guilt — caring for people makes them targets.

chapters.title: The Bait
chapters.summary: Teodor's POV. Captured and interrogated by the Agency's summit security chief, Director Rehn, Teodor learns the truth: the extraction was always the trap — Nadia is the bait, and Ivo the loose end. He escapes with the confirmation but not cleanly, wounded, and must decide whether telling Ivo will break her or arm her. Beat: sacrifice and terrible clarity.

chapters.title: Summit
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Instead of running, Ivo walks Nadia into the summit perimeter using her investigator credentials and the forged access, planning to detonate the truth publicly during the opening session. Rehn springs the trap early; Teodor's warning saves them by minutes. In the chaos, Nadia uploads the archive to every delegate's terminal. Beat: all-or-nothing climax, courage over fear.

chapters.title: After the Wreckage
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The exposure fractures the summit; Rehn falls, investigations begin, and Ivo finally learns the full truth of row twelve — including that Hale died trying to stop it. She buries her family a second time, properly this time, with Nadia and Teodor beside her. Beat: grief transmuted into resolve; a found family standing where blood used to be.
